common_rules: Every worker program path is a configured absolute path. The bridge never guesses a worker through PATH.
The bridge injects no consumption budget, no default task deadline, no automatic model fallback and no automatic retry.
The bridge never approves or proxies a worker approval prompt. An adapter that cannot recognize an explicit input/approval signal declares needs_input=false.
Only the configured environment allowlist is forwarded to the worker; credential files are never opened.

required_env lists worker environment variables that must be present in addition to the bridge baseline and explicit env_allowlist. The bridge never auto-forwards them; a missing required variable surfaces as a native worker failure, not a credential read or a silent fallback.
A configured version below minimum_version is rejected with INCOMPATIBLE_CLI.

Native worker session/transcript persistence must be disabled by the fixed invocation. Otherwise submission rejects with NATIVE_SESSION_PERSISTENCE_UNSUPPORTED before acceptance/spawn. Optional final Markdown does not enable native sessions.

adapters.program: configured absolute path to the codex binary
adapters.argv_notes: The -s value is the configured sandbox (read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access). --skip-git-repo-check is included only when configured true (default true). -m <model> is inserted before the final - only when a model is configured. The final - means the task is read from stdin. Native session persistence is disabled by --ephemeral. observed_argv and live_success_evidence describe historical captures before this policy.

terminal_success.rule: exit code 0 AND a turn.completed event AND a non-empty item.completed agent_message text. A turn.failed event or a stream error event is a failure even when a partial agent message was printed. Exit 0 alone, or a final-looking message alone, is never success.
required_signals: event item.completed with item.type == agent_message and non-empty text

adapters.program: configured absolute path to the claude binary
adapters.argv_notes: The configured permission_mode must be one of acceptEdits, auto, manual, dontAsk or plan; bypassPermissions is rejected. Optional --allowedTools <comma-separated> and --model <model> are appended when configured. The task is written to stdin. The observed live failure used only -p --output-format json and a prompt on stdin. Native session persistence is disabled by --no-session-persistence. observed_argv and live_success_evidence describe historical captures before this policy.

terminal_success.rule: exit code 0 AND a single result object with type=result, subtype=success, is_error=false and a non-empty result string. subtype=success together with is_error=true is a native failure (observed trap), not a success. A success object with an empty result is STREAM_INCOMPLETE.

adapters.needs_input_signal: A result object with is_error=true, a non-empty permission_denials array and an empty result maps to NEEDS_INPUT. With --permission-prompts none the CLI denies instead of prompting; the bridge does not approve or queue a prompt.

terminal_success.rule: exit code 0 AND status phase=turn_end with reason.kind=completed AND a non-empty final event text AND no run-level error event. A final event alone, or exit 0 alone, is never success.
failure_signals: completed turn_end with empty final text (STREAM_INCOMPLETE)

adapters.program: configured absolute node runner plus configured absolute path to zcode.cjs
adapters.argv_notes: The program is the configured node runner and the first argument is the configured zcode.cjs path. mode must be one of build, edit, plan or guarded; yolo is rejected because it bypasses approvals. The task travels in argv, not stdin. --prompt otherwise defaults to --mode yolo, so a mode is always explicit. Model/provider selection is owned by the ZCode CLI configuration; the bridge does not override it (there is no verified headless --model flag). The headless CLI has no --model flag; model/provider selection comes from the ZCode provider configuration. The headless path does not resolve the account-provider defaultModelSelection (account:bigmodel-individual-coding-plan) and falls back to the first personal provider. For the BigModel coding plan, configure a personal API-key provider (api=anthropic-messages, baseUrl=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic, model=GLM-5.3-Flash) and select it as the default. This historical argv is not currently launchable: native session suppression is unverified.

terminal_success.rule: exit code 0 AND stdout parses as one JSON object with a non-empty response string. The installed headless CLI omits the type field in the ordinary path; type=result is also accepted, but any other explicit type is a native failure. Empty stdout with a non-zero exit is classified from stderr. Empty stdout with exit 0, or an object without response text, is STREAM_INCOMPLETE.
failure_signals: empty stdout with non-zero exit (native failure from stderr)
